note: Real-world size of each subject, in metres. Generated meshes are normalised to a unit bounding box, so they carry no scale of their own -- a whale exports shorter than a snail unless something supplies it. This file is that something. Both the FBX export and the inspection scene read it.
axis_field: Each subject says WHICH dimension its number describes. 'height' is the vertical extent, which is what a person means for a standing character, a tower or a tree. 'longest' is the largest extent on any axis, which is what a person means for a boat or a whale -- where the long axis is the one being pictured and which way is up barely matters. Assuming one rule for both is how a 12 m boat ends up 3 m long.
accuracy: Values marked user are specified. The rest are estimates chosen to make a lineup readable and an Unreal import land at a sane size -- not measurements, and nothing downstream should treat them as authoritative. Edit and rebuild.
